summary: Completed testing of password management features and dashboard history tabs. All features working correctly: Admin create user sets must_change_password=true, login returns flag, change-password endpoint updates password and clears flag, admin reset-password sets flag, /api/auth/me returns flag. Dashboard Active/History tabs working. Force Password Change screen appears for users with must_change_password=true and redirects to dashboard after successful change.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/users correctly sets must_change_password=true for admin-created users
POST /api/auth/login correctly returns must_change_password in user object
POST /api/auth/change-password correctly updates password and sets must_change_password=false
PUT /api/users/{id}/reset-password correctly resets password and sets must_change_password=true
Password validation working (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit required)
Dashboard Active/History tabs have correct data-testid attributes
Force Password Change screen has all required elements with data-testid attributes
User is redirected to normal dashboard after changing password

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 core tests passed, 3 fixture errors due to rate limiting)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted forcechangetest@test.com user to test Force Password Change flow
context_for_next_testing_agent: Password features fully implemented: 1) Admin creates user with temp password -> must_change_password=true, 2) User logs in and sees ForcePasswordChange screen, 3) User changes password -> must_change_password=false and redirected to dashboard, 4) Admin can reset password via dropdown menu -> must_change_password=true. Dashboard has Active/History tabs with data-testid='dashboard-active-tab' and 'dashboard-history-tab'. User Management has 'Temporary Password' field in create dialog (default 'Changeme1') and 'Reset Password' option in dropdown menu (data-testid='reset-password-{id}'). Rate limiting active: 5/min login, so space out login tests.
